summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report a foreign regulatory announcement made to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. On July 9, 2026, the company granted conditional awards under its International Employee Share Purchase Plan to employees, covering 273,474.84948 ordinary shares. The purchase price is GBP 0, vesting over 2 years 3 months, with no performance conditions. This is a routine equity grant, not a special situation. It maps to a standard equity compensation disclosure.
